    49	    neg = {}
    50	    for v in range(1, num_vars + 1):
    51	        p = 3 + 2 * (v - 1)
    52	        q = p + 1
    53	        pos[v] = p
    54	        neg[v] = q
    55	        add(p, q)   # one of them is colour 0, the other colour 1
    56	        add(p, 2)   # neither may use the base colour 2
    57	        add(q, 2)
    58	
    59	    n = 3 + 2 * num_vars
    60	
    61	    # Clause gadgets.
    62	    for clause in clauses:
    63	        a, b, c = (pos[lit] if lit > 0 else neg[-lit] for lit in clause)
    64	        p, q, r = n, n + 1, n + 2
    65	        n += 3
    66	        add(p, q)   # triangle on the three fresh vertices
    67	        add(q, r)
    68	        add(r, p)
    69	        add(p, a)   # attach the triangle to the clause's literals
    70	        add(q, b)
    71	        add(r, c)
    72	
    73	    return {"n": n, "edges": edges}
